contea di ritrovamento: Greater London (Inghilterra e Galles)

An Early Medieval (Anglo Saxon) silver coin: penny of Eadmund, King of all England (AD939-946). Dimensions: diameter: 22.49mm; thickness: 0.93mm; weight: 1.37g. Obverse: Small cross pattee Obverse inscription: EADMVND REX Reverse: Moneyer’s name in two lines divided by three crosses and above and below name a trefoil Reverse inscription: AEDELVINE Moneyer: Aelfwine or Aethelwine Die axis…
